freightlogistics.ponder.management.text_: Right click to open the company control dashboard.
View accepted freight orders and control your company.
Contracts consume real items before issuing payment.
freightlogistics.ponder.rack.text_1: Right click to access the component bays.
freightlogistics.ponder.rack.text_2: Install a CPU, RAM, storage drive, network card and cooling.
freightlogistics.ponder.rack.text_3: The parts stay installed when you save and reload the world.
freightlogistics.ponder.depot.text_1: Place a Create Train Station beside your depot controller.
freightlogistics.ponder.depot.text_2: Use the Depot menu to register the nearby station.
freightlogistics.ponder.depot.text_3: Enable automatic parking to return idle Create trains home.
freightlogistics.ponder.warehouse.text_1: Right click the warehouse to open the cargo inventory.
freightlogistics.ponder.warehouse.text_2: Store freight materials in its twenty-seven slots.
freightlogistics.ponder.warehouse.text_3: The items remain stored after the world is saved.
freightlogistics.ponder.market.text_1: Your company earns credits by completing freight contracts.
freightlogistics.ponder.market.text_2: Spend credits in the Marketplace menu to obtain components.
freightlogistics.ponder.market.text_3: Place the components inside your Industrial Server Rack.
freightlogistics.ponder.factory.text_1: Install a controller beside your Create factory.
freightlogistics.ponder.factory.text_2: This controller currently opens its status interface.
freightlogistics.ponder.factory.text_3: Automated factory production is an upcoming integration.
freightlogistics.ponder.crossing.text_1: Power the crossing signal with redstone to turn it on.
freightlogistics.ponder.crossing.text_2: Connect barriers and warning lamps to the same control line.
freightlogistics.ponder.crossing.text_3: Train approach detection is not automatic in this version.
